note: novel (Novel) — SMG / Defender / Iron / Burst II, cd 20s, ammo 120, hitsPerShot 1. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-03: FROM-SCRATCH build (no shipped override existed; simSupported was false) — test-first re-derivation (scripts/tests/units/novel.test.ts, groups N1-N5). Her identity is the Cornucopia stack engine: every 100 landed normal attacks builds a stack (cap 5) and her burst's Damage-Taken mark only lands while Cornucopia is at max stacks. MODELED: (S1) 52.36% of final ATK to 'the 3 enemies with the highest final DEF' on the datamined 10s skill cooldown — trigger interval:10 (engine interval phase, first fire t=10 — neve/snow-white precedent for CD-bearing auto-cast skills); the 3-highest-DEF targeting clause collapses to the single scope-lock boss ({kind:'enemy'} documented stand-in, moves no damage — there is no enemy roster in v1). Bare flatDamage rider defaults (crit-eligible, no core, skill bucket, FB-major by landing timing; none stated in prose). (S2) Cornucopia = ONE hitCount:100 block with two effects in kit order: (1) self defPct 13.5, maxStacks 5, durationSec 15 — the literal DEF▲ stack line (each application adds a stack to the cap and refreshes the 15s window; at her SMG cadence a new stack lands every ~5s so the cap holds once reached — faithful accrual, not a steady-state fudge); defPct is damage-INERT in v1 (self DEF never feeds own damage; proven byte-identical totals with the block removed). (2) resource cornucopia +1 (pool 0..5) — the stack COUNT the burst gate reads: the engine has no own-buff-stack gate, so the named-stack count is tracked as a live resource (soda-twinkling-bunny Golden-Chip pattern); pool is monotonic (no decay), faithful because at her fire rate stacks always refresh before the 15s expiry could drop one (see caveats). (BURST) line 1: 330.61% of final ATK Burst Skill damage to 'the 1 enemy with the highest final ATK' — burstCast nuke, auto-FB-exempt by cast timing (the cast lands before the Full Burst window opens); targeting collapses to the single boss. Line 2: 'Activates when Cornucopia is at max stacks. Affects 1 enemy. Damage Taken ▲ 67.5% for 5 sec' — burstCast + resourceGate {cornucopia, min:5} → enemy damageTakenPct 67.5/5s (a boss-held taken-bucket debuff, team-wide amp in-window). Casts before the 5th stack accrues correctly land WITHOUT the mark (gate proven load-bearing by the counterfactual). UNMODELED (verbatim in unmodeled): the S1 'DEF ▼ 7.05% for 5 sec' enemy debuff — the engine has no dynamic enemy-DEF-reduction primitive (applyBuff ignores enemy ATK▼/DEF▼; cfg.bossDef is a fixed per-hit subtraction; damageTakenPct is a separate bucket — mast Sea-Breeze precedent). Magnitude ~0.02% team damage (7.05% of the 140-DEF scope-lock boss = 9.87 flat DEF off a ~50k effective-ATK term): a minor secondary effect, not load-bearing. No heal/shield/gauge/ammo/reload lines in this kit. Element: clean ×1.10 Iron advantage on an advantaged boss is engine-handled (no elemental-advantage buff in kit). TIER 2: stack/status gate (Cornucopia-max gate on the burst debuff).
caveats: skill1: cadence is the DATAMINED skill cooldown (interval 10s); first-fire phase (t=10 vs t=0) is the engine interval convention (⚑, neve/snow-white precedent). 'Affects 3 enemy unit(s) with the highest final DEF' collapses to the single boss — v1 fields one immortal enemy, so the selection clause is a moot documented stand-in (neve precedent)

skill1: the DEF ▼ 7.05%/5s enemy debuff is UNMODELED — no dynamic enemy-DEF-reduction primitive (cfg.bossDef is fixed; damageTakenPct is a different bucket). At the 140-DEF scope-lock boss this is 9.87 flat DEF ≈ ~0.02% team damage — minor, not load-bearing. Recipe if a primitive lands: a boss-DEF-reduction debuff (7.05% for 5s, refreshed on the 10s skill CD) feeding the subtractive DEF term

skill2: Cornucopia's 15s per-stack EXPIRY is not tracked by the resource gate pool (resources are monotonic — soda Golden-Chip precedent). Divergence from the real kit is only possible during >15s firing gaps, where stacks would decay; at novel's SMG cadence (~19 shots/s, one stack per ~5.3s) sustained combat always refreshes before expiry, so the pool equals the real stack count in every fight the sim models. The DEF▲ buff itself DOES carry the 15s expiry + 5-stack cap (faithful accrual, observable in the event log)

skill2: 'landing 100 normal attacks' is encoded as hitCount:100 — the counter advances by hitsPerShot per trigger pull (novel hitsPerShot 1, so 100 shots = 100 hits); SMG shots at scope lock do not miss

burst: the Damage-Taken mark targets '1 enemy unit(s)' — unspecified WHICH enemy in prose; with one boss it is boss-held regardless (enemy buffs key on the enemyBuffs list). Gate reads the PRE-fire pool at cast time; casts before the 5th Cornucopia stack accrue land without the mark — faithful to 'Activates when Cornucopia is at max stacks'
